analysis_unit: profile-level observation within fluid-specific cohort; patient-level dependence cannot be assessed from the public matrix
source_clinical_qc_note: The source study reports excluding five CSF and one plasma profiles by sequencing QC. The authors' archived Quality controls.R constructs meta_good after these exclusions and writes the 159-profile Supplementary Data matrix from meta_good; all 159 public-matrix profiles are therefore author-QC-retained, while the six excluded profiles are absent.
